in_marathi.name: Jyoshna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyoshna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jyoshna is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jyot' which means 'knowledge' and 'Sna' which means 'Goddess'. This name signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom.
